title: Scout H-S2 (gap matrix, handover sections 6-11): packets, bounded results and bus deltas, repair stopping rules and failure signatures, resume compatibility, review binding, Jev cost, memory and snapshot hygiene, scope enforcement at the sandbox boundary
spec:
READ THE CODE AT /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/wt/goal-T-0260 (goal/T-0260 head 2ca1517), NOT your worktree base (it is stale). Read-only. Cite path:line from that tree.
Handover doc: /Users/k3ntaw/Documents/orchestrator-efficiency-handover.md sections 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 (read those sections once).
Files to read (targeted): orchestrator/spawn.py (packet, bounded_diff, bounded_text, render, run_worker, base_for, scoped_diff), orchestrator/bus_mcp.py and orchestrator/bus.py (bus_events since cursor, pagination, compact reads), orchestrator/daemon.py (auto_fix_round, root, lineage, failure id extraction, escalation, report_merge reconciliation, _review_plan, semantic triggers, reviewed_sha binding, rebase re-assessment), orchestrator/merge.py (_diff_hash, rebase guard, gate runs), orchestrator/executor.py (codex_reply resume: compatibility checks), orchestrator/repomap.py, orchestrator/jev_gate.py and orchestrator/jev.py (modes, sample rate, block rules, redaction, log volume under .orchestrator/runs/jev), orchestrator/handover.py (auto-handover writer to plan.md every 15 min), .claude/skills/memory/scripts (recall provenance/freshness, record, compact), .claude/hooks/scope-guard.sh and tests-green.sh, .orchestrator/prompts/*.md (length in lines, duplicated contract text), .orchestrator/pool.toml ([limits], [jev], [review]). Run evidence: count rows and bytes in .orchestrator/runs/jev/*.jsonl (at the repo root /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/.orchestrator/runs/jev) and note the gate_mode in force; count Auto-handover sections appended to plan.md in git log -p of .orchestrator/plan.md over 2026-09-19 (how many rewrites the daemon caused).
Produce a matrix, one row per handover requirement in sections 6-11, columns: requirement · status (existing and verified / partial / missing / unnecessary) · evidence path:line · gap and the smallest change that closes it (or why unnecessary) · verification (existing test name, or the test to write) · confidence 0-1.
Requirements to cover at minimum: packet has hash/version and provenance, never drops objective/acceptance/constraints, decision and repair packet fields, expansion handles; expansion reads and repair rates tracked; role prompts short with no duplicated contract injection (measure lines per prompt); test results as summary plus log reference with failing ids; search and diff truncation marked visibly, empty vs truncated distinct; bus deltas since a durable cursor with pagination and no silent loss; memory retrieval with provenance and freshness; read-only result cache keyed by tree version incl. uncommitted files (exists? unnecessary?); tasks defined by coherent behaviour, five-file limit a warning; automatic repair only in scope, lineage preserved, originals reconciled only after verified merge; failure kinds distinguished (code defect, invalid spec, flaky, env, conflict, quota, permissions) and routed; normalized failure signature and stop on unchanged repeat; configurable retry budget; resume only when worktree/version compatible; stop when acceptance met, no mandatory essays; Jev: modes, sampled scoring, judge cost vs savings measured, duplicate-read reuse, kill switch, deterministic protections independent; memory: source/scope/confidence/version, superseded marks, dedupe, expiry; append-only audit vs small snapshot, plan.md writer ownership; review: behaviour-based triggers, approval bound to reviewed sha and re-assessed after rebase, executor claims separated from verified facts, zero-model checks, scope enforcement for Codex at the sandbox boundary vs post-run diff, test-result cache preconditions.
Also list which of the handover's required regression cases (section Delivery order, bullet list) already have a test (name it) and which do not.
Output cap 1,500 tokens: matrix rows first, then the regression-case list, then at most 5 lines of what surprised you. No prose introduction.
acceptance: every listed requirement has a matrix row with a status, a path:line from wt/goal-T-0260 or 'none found', and a verification entry
Jev log volume, gate_mode and the Auto-handover rewrite count are reported as numbers
output under 1,500 tokens, no code changes

findings.claim: Packet has no hash/version/provenance field at all — MISSING
Objective/base/write_scope/verify never dropped; acceptance only summarized (5+'N more in task', full task via bus_read) when packet>4800 chars — PARTIAL, existing safeguard not a hard 'never'
Repair packet has spec ref/failing criterion/error/current state; decision-specific packet (options/prev decision) not in spawn.packet, only fix-round exists — PARTIAL
Expansion handles exist on bounded text/diff ('expand with: <cmd>') — EXISTING
No counter/metric found for packet-expansion reads or repair rates — MISSING (not exhaustively searched)

Role prompts short, no duplicated contract text: 94 total lines across 9 files (challenge 3, execute 8, fix-delta 5, fix-round 25, planner-decision 3, planner 22, review 7, scout 13, spec-review 8) — EXISTING
Diff truncation visibly marked with 'N more lines; expand'; empty relevant_tests marked '(none found)' distinct from truncation marker — EXISTING
Test-result summary+log path not directly verified this pass (tests-green.sh only line-counted, content unread) — UNVERIFIED
bus_events(since,limit) is seq-ordered, seq>since, monotonic — no silent loss, but no role filter (handover asked for role-filtered) — PARTIAL
Memory recall prints provenance and freshness/age columns per hit — EXISTING
No read-only result cache keyed by tree version + uncommitted files found; only a pre-merge dirty-scope check exists, not a discovery/read cache — MISSING or unnecessary (unclear)
bus_create_task enforces acceptance+scope only, not a 5-file hard cap (matches 'warning not hard rule' intent) — EXISTING/appropriate
Automatic repair only within scope (path-matched review comments, gate_red test ids), lineage via root()/lineage(), originals reconciled only when merge.status=='merged' — EXISTING

Only gate_red vs review-request_changes are distinguished as 'routine'; flaky/env/quota/permissions not explicitly classified in auto_fix_round (merge.py separately flags conflict/tests_red/diff_unavailable) — PARTIAL

auto_fix_hold_key dedupes on held_at timestamp, not a normalized content signature — stops duplicate fix-round creation but isn't the 'ignore timestamp, keep meaningful diff' signature the handover wants — PARTIAL/backwards
Retry budgets configurable: pool.toml [daemon].auto_fix_rounds=2, executor.py MAX_ROUNDS=5 for codex resume — EXISTING
codex_reply resume checks thread exists + executor availability only; no explicit worktree/version compatibility check before resuming — PARTIAL/gap

open_questions: Which specific test functions cover each Delivery-order regression case (idle-tick zero-calls, duplicate-claim dedup, budget-reservation cap, cooldown-no-retry-loop, cache-key-with-uncommitted-files, self-certify-blocked) — needs per-test-file reads beyond this turn budget
Does memory (decisions.md/gotchas.md) implement superseded-marking, dedupe, or expiry — not checked this pass
Is there any duplicate-read reuse cache anywhere in orchestrator/ outside jev_gate's judge-based 'redundant' question — grep was not exhaustive
suggested_next: Read .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh and orchestrator/repomap.py directly for test-result-summary and symbol-map claims
grep tests/*.py for function names matching each Delivery-order regression bullet to build the test-coverage table
Check orchestrator/pool.toml reservation/budget logic and test_pool.py for the 'simultaneous workers cannot over-reserve' case
